claim: A full demo campaign offers three distinct named contract choices with quotas.
sandbox: open /demo, choose Play full demo, and assert every client, product, and quota

claim: Each campaign seed produces the same contract choices per chapter.
sandbox: compare core output for equal seeds and selected different seeds

claim: Six routing chapters reach a final ending, and a new campaign returns to chapter one.
sandbox: open /demo, start the full demo, complete six scripted routes, dismantle, finish, and restart

claim: The full campaign has no repeated progress reset, ads, energy limits, loot boxes, or paid progress.
sandbox: complete the full demo while inspecting every state, control, link, and request

claim: Campaign progress saves in this browser and does not advance while the page is closed.
sandbox: start a demo shift, record persisted remainingMs, close the page, reopen, and assert an equal paused value

claim: Production pauses while the game tab is hidden.
sandbox: background an active demo tab, assert persisted paused state and a stable timer, then restore it

claim: Players can export, preview, and restore a campaign record as JSON.
sandbox: export the seeded demo, change its save, import the file, preview replacement, confirm, and compare storage

claim: Demo actions never read or overwrite the real campaign save and send no game data to another origin.
sandbox: create a valid real save; exercise demo play, full demo, reset, and Start for real; compare the real save byte for byte and record requests

claim: The sample opens in chapter two with a complete route and a 10× demo clock.
sandbox: open /demo, assert four named route slots, and measure about ten simulated seconds per wall-clock second

claim: The game works offline after the first visit.
sandbox: use a fresh browser context, control /demo with its service worker, go offline, and reload

claim: The sound choice persists and is stored separately for demo and real play.
sandbox: change demo sound, reload, then open real play and compare the control state

claim: Each production shift has a five-minute simulated timer.
sandbox: open /demo and assert the visible duration and timer

claim: Routes can be planned with pointer, touch, or keyboard input.
sandbox: open /demo and place route stations with pointer, keyboard, and a fresh 390px touch context

claim: Play needs no account and has no analytics, checkout, payment form, or cross-origin game-data requests.
sandbox: crawl every route from a fresh demo flow, inspect controls and scripts, and record all requests

claim: Active-shift rendering has a p95 frame interval at or below 20 ms in the test browser.
sandbox: open /demo, start its sample shift, and measure 120 animation-frame intervals

claim: Bonus contracts are unavailable while operator registration is pending.
sandbox: crawl every route, inspect purchase controls, and verify the Terms body and metadata

claim: Both /demo and /?demo=1 open the isolated sample game.
sandbox: open each documented demo URL and assert the demo banner

claim: The deterministic simulation advances in fixed 100 ms steps.
sandbox: compare 120 fixed 100ms core steps with one equivalent 12-second step

claim: The self-hosted fonts use the SIL Open Font License, and the generated social artwork is original to Finite Foundry.
sandbox: open /demo and verify local font loading, license record, artwork prompt record, and social image
